_source: Captured 2026-09-08 from a real audit on production, and the same run the flow video on the landing page shows — the numbers here are the numbers it ends on. sample-bill.pdf + sample-eob.pdf (TESTING.md plan E1) against gemini-3.6-flash WITH the Acme Silver PPO plan on file, which is why three coinsurance_mismatch findings quote the SBC. The bill and the patient are synthetic — Jane Q. Testpatient at St. Verification General Hospital — which is why this can be published. Only the three fields renderReport() reads are kept; the stored audit's bill/eob document text, patientName, statementId, tokens and timestamps are deliberately absent. Do not hand-edit the figures: their value is that a real run produced them.

findings.description: Comprehensive metabolic panel (CPT 80053) is billed twice on the itemized statement for the same date of service, but only one unit was processed on the EOB.
The provider statement shows a balance due of $845.00, which exceeds the EOB total member responsibility of $186.35 by $658.65.

findings.description: The individual line item patient responsibility amounts on the EOB sum to $168.35, but the EOB claim total states patient responsibility as $186.35, resulting in an arithmetic error of $18.00.
